## Dataset Overview

The Gapminder dataset tracks historical socio-economic metrics across countries and continents between 1952 and 2007. Key variables include life expectancy (`lifeExp`), population (`pop`), and GDP per capita (`gdpPercap`).

```{python}
#| echo: true
#| warning: false

import pandas as pd
from gapminder import gapminder

gapminder.head()
```

## Regional Summary (2007)

Comparing median life expectancy and GDP per capita across continents in the most recent survey year:

```{python}
#| echo: true
#| code-fold: true

recent_summary = (
    gapminder[gapminder["year"] == 2007]
    .groupby("continent")
    .agg(
        median_life_exp=("lifeExp", "median"),
        median_gdp=("gdpPercap", "median"),
        total_pop=("pop", "sum"),
        country_count=("country", "count")
    )
    .sort_values(by="median_life_exp", ascending=False)
    .reset_index()
)

recent_summary
```

## 55-Year Progress (1952 vs 2007)

```{python}
#| echo: true

comparison = (
    gapminder[gapminder["year"].isin([1952, 2007])]
    .groupby(["continent", "year"])["lifeExp"]
    .mean()
    .unstack()
    .rename(columns={1952: "life_exp_1952", 2007: "life_exp_2007"})
)

comparison["gain_years"] = comparison["life_exp_2007"] - comparison["life_exp_1952"]
comparison.round(2)
```

Every continent experienced double-digit gains in average life expectancy between 1952 and 2007, with Asia demonstrating the largest absolute increase over that span.

### Visualizing Regional Life Expectancy (2007)

```{python}
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| code-fold: true

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 5))
ax.bar(recent_summary['continent'], recent_summary['median_life_exp'], color='royalblue')
ax.set_title('Median Life Expectancy by Continent (2007)')
ax.set_ylabel('Median Life Expectancy (years)')
ax.set_xlabel('Continent')
plt.show()
```
